entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi... I think I need to make a return. I'm just finding this whole thing very confusing.
I can certainly look into that for you. To pull up your account, could I get your name and order number, please?
Yes, it's Sarah Jenkins, and the order number is... uhm... VF88-12590.
Thank you, Sarah. I see you ordered the VeloBand Cadence Sensor. It looks like it was delivered on January 1st. What specifically seems to be the issue with the device?
Oh, I don't know... it's just so hard to use. I read the user manual, but the interface is just... confusing. I really expected more, you know? It's not working the way I thought it would.
I'm sorry to hear that it's not meeting your expectations. Let me just check the return eligibility for you. One moment.
Okay... I just feel so lost with it. Can't you just help me?

Of course. And thank you for your patience. Okay, I've checked our policy. I see your order was delivered 23 days ago, and you are well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process that return for you right now.
Oh! You can? That's such a relief. I was so worried I was stuck with it. Thank you so much.

You're very welcome, Sarah. I've just initiated the return. You'll receive an email with a prepaid shipping label within the next 15 minutes. Just print that out, attach it to the original box, and drop it off at any post office. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's perfect. You've been a great help. Thank you, David.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
